subject: Side-by-side booth coordination with Nimbus Cloud — shared demo handoff & signage plan
messages:
From: Sally Huang <sally@nimboevents.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: partnerships@nimboevents.com
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Side-by-side sponsorship opportunity at CloudScale — propose shared demo portal

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the quick chat last week. Nimbus Cloud is confirmed as a nearby sponsor to Redwood on the expo hall map, and the events team suggested we explore a side-by-side collaboration rather than competing demo footprints. High level idea: a small shared demo portal (3x3ft counter) between our island and your kiosk for cross-product handoffs, co-branded signage, and a short joint demo that routes traffic between both tables.

Before we get into legal and approvals, can you confirm if Redwood is open to:
- Allowing a co-branded 24" tabletop sign and a 36" hanging banner in the shared portal area
- Providing a short 90-second handoff demo that we can script on our side (we can adapt)
- Sharing a power drop (if feasible) or routing a short extension from your PSU

I attached a sketched layout for the shared portal (adjacent_booth_diagram_v3.pdf) and a quick mock of co-brand sign placement.

If this sounds reasonable, can we schedule a 30-minute ops sync with your events lead and our AV vendor (Apex AV)? We’d like to finalize physical footprint and signage specs by next Friday so the show-print deadline is met.

Appreciate it —
Sally

Sally Huang
Senior Events Manager, Nimbus Cloud
Sally@nimboevents.com
Attachment: adjacent_booth_diagram_v3.pdf (PDF 1.1MB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sally Huang <sally@nimboevents.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Side-by-side sponsorship opportunity at CloudScale — propose shared demo portal

Thanks Sally — this is an interesting idea and I appreciate the sketch. Marissa (events) and Laura (logistics) are looped to surface any constraints.

Quick answers:
- Co-branded tabletop sign: likely yes, subject to venue hanging/bannering rules (Laura can confirm).
- Hanging banner: we need dimensions and vendor cert; hangs over shared portal may require show approval — please share spec.
- Power: we typically reserve dedicated leverage for demo racks; sharing a PSU is possible but we need the extension/location confirmed and sign-off from on-site ops.

Marissa — can you take point on verifying the hanging restrictions and print deadlines? Laura — can you check if we can route a short extension from our PSU to the adjacent counter (safest approach is to reserve a small distro).

Sally — happy to do a 30-minute ops sync. Wed 10/21 11:00-11:30 PT or Thu 10/22 2:00-2:30 PT work for me.

-Karthik
VP, Field Marketing
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sally Huang <sally@nimboevents.com>, ops@apexav.com
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Side-by-side sponsorship opportunity at CloudScale — propose shared demo portal

Hi Sally,

Thanks — looping in Apex AV so they can weigh in on power and AV handoff. A few logistics and proposed rules of engagement from Redwood events ops:

1) Physical footprint and sightlines
- Proposal: 3'x3' shared portal counter located on the aisle between booths #B12 (Redwood) and #B14 (Nimbus). See attached diagram.
- We will add a low-profile floor treatment (mat) to mark the handoff zone; no permanent fixtures into expo flooring.

2) Signage and brand lockups
- Tabletop sign (24" x 8") co-branded: acceptable with both artwork files provided 72 hours prior to print cutoff.
- Hanging banner (36" x 18") above portal: subject to show permit. If Nimbus obtains the hanging permit, we need vendor cert and anchoring plan. No motorized elements.

3) Power & AV
- Apex AV: recommended approach is to run a 6ft distro from Redwood's demo table (we can supply one GFCI-protected outlet) to the portal. Apex, please confirm load (amps) and whether a separate circuit is required for Nimbus' unit.

4) Demo handoff cadence & staffing
- We propose scheduled handoffs every 20 minutes during peak hours (11:00–12:40, 14:00–16:00) with a 90-second scripted transfer. Each side will have a one-page handoff script.

5) Approvals & deadlines
- Print cutoff (floor decals / tabletop signs): Fri 10/30 EOD.
- Hanging permit decision: Tue 10/27 EOD.

Attached: cobrand_signage_specs.xlsx (sign sizes, bleed, safe zones) and the annotated diagram (same file referenced earlier). Also putting the drive folder here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1abcdExample

Apex AV (ops@apexav.com) — please reply with confirmation of power approach and any constraints by EOD tomorrow so we can lock the call with show ops.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Sr. Events Program Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachment: cobrand_signage_specs.xlsx (XLSX 45KB)

Perfect — thanks Marissa, Karthik. Apex AV (Ops) confirmed on power: they can run a 6ft distro from Redwood's table, single 20A circuit should be sufficient for the demo units we described (they requested an extra amp headroom).

We’ll proceed with the hanging permit application today and share vendor certs. For the ops sync: Wed 10/28 11:00 PT is good on our side — does that work for Redwood? If yes, I’ll send a calendar invite and include show ops contact (Tina Chen).

Final: we’ll upload co-brand artwork to the drive folder by Mon 10/26 and aim to meet your Fri 10/30 print cutoff.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — excited to trial a joint demo flow.

Best,
Sally
